prBodyNotes: **Manual finish required** before merge: bump `version` in `Chart.yaml`, update `appVersion` if the application image changed, add an `artifacthub.io/changes` entry, then run `helm lint charts/<chart> --strict` and `helm unittest charts/<chart>` (see `standards-check.yml` / GR-079).

packageRules.description: Container image tags in chart values.yaml (image / controller.image / server.image / app.image / ...). One PR per image; never automerge - each needs a Chart.yaml version bump + artifacthub changelog.
Chart.yaml cohesion: update appVersion alongside the image tag when the same chart is touched.
HelmForge OCI subchart dependencies (oci://ghcr.io/helmforgedev/helm). Grouped into one PR; never automerge.
GitHub Actions pins in .github/workflows. Grouped, ci-labelled to match the existing Dependabot convention.
Digest-only updates are never automerged (charts pin tags, not digests).
Major bumps always need manual review + k3d validation.
